# Objet

Traitement du fichier copro EE pour obtenir des cartes format A4 pour pwp


# Librairies et répertoire

```{r}
library(sf)
library(mapsf)
chemin <-  paste0(Sys.getenv('HOME'), "/03_SIG/03_03_Data/")
```




# Données

## Fond carto


```{r}
quartier <- st_read("../data/tt.gpkg", "quartier")
```


```{r}
copro <- st_read("../data/coproff_bondy.gpkg",  quiet = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
names(copro)
type <- names(table(copro$typ_prop_f))
type <- type [grep("Copropri", type, ignore.case = T )]
copro <-  copro [copro$typ_prop_f %in% type,]
table(copro$typ_prop_f)
mf_map(quartier, type="typo",   var= "nom", alpha = 0.3, border = NA, leg_pos = NA)
mf_map(copro, var = "typ_prop_f", type = "typo", add = T, border=NA)
names(copro)
```

faire 3 cartes

```{r}
png("../img/EE_typeCopro.png", width = 4000, height = 2000, res = 400 )
par(mfrow = c(1,3))
for (t in type){
  tmp <- copro [copro$typ_prop_f == t,]
  mf_map(quartier, type="typo",   var= "nom", alpha = 0.3, border = NA, leg_pos = NA)
  mf_map(tmp, var = "typ_prop_f", col= "black",add = T, border=NA)
  mf_layout(paste0(t, " (", length(tmp$typ_prop_f),")"), "")
}
dev.off()
```


# typologie


```{r}
table(copro$typ_log)
var <- "type_log"

```

```{r}

  mf_map(tmp, var = "typ_prop_f", col= "black",add = T, border=NA)
  mf_layout(paste0(t, " (", length(tmp$typ_prop_f),")"), "")
```
